Method of Attack: Spear phishing emails redirecting victims to malicious domains
Redirection to seemingly innocuous domains like run.mocky[.]io
Use of legitimate services like Mocky and webhook[.]site to evade detection
DLL side-loading to execute malicious batch scripts
Disguised ZIP archive containing malicious payloads
Attack Vector: Malicious links in spear phishing emails
Execution of disguised malicious files (e.g., Windows Calculator binary masquerading as a JPG image file)
